([[Sandy Springs, Georgia]]) | college = [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina]] (2025–2026) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = * Consensus second-team [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] ([[2026 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2026]]) * First-team [[List of All-Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball teams|All-ACC]] (2026) * [[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] All-Rookie team (2026) * [[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]] ([[2025 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2025]]) * [[Jordan Brand Classic]] (2025) * [[Mr. Georgia Basketball]] (2025) }} '''Caleb Noah Sheldon Wilson''' (born July 18, 2006) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina Tar Heels]]. He was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2025 class. ==Early life and high school career== Wilson was born and grew up in [[Atlanta|Atlanta, Georgia]] and attended [[Holy Innocents' Episcopal School]].{{cite web|url=https://www.newsobserver.com/sports/college/acc/unc/article277061528.html|title=UNC basketball recruit update on Caleb Wilson of Atlanta|work=[[The News & Observer]]|date=July 6, 2023|access-date=October 22, 2024}} He averaged 14.5 points, 12.6 rebounds, 5.2 blocks, 3.9 assists, and 1.2 steals per game during his sophomore year.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/north-carolina/longformarticle/unc-basketball-recruiting-board-class-of-2025-172524742/|title=UNC Basketball Recruiting Board: Class of 2025|first=Sean|last=Moran|website=[[247Sports]]|date=January 23, 2025|access-date=January 31, 2025}} Wilson averaged 21 points, 15 rebounds, and over 4 blocks per game as a junior.{{cite web|url=https://www.slamonline.com/the-magazine/251/caleb-wilson-251/|title=Caleb Wilson Studied the Legends of the Game, Now He’s Channeling Their Wisdom as He Makes His Own Mark as a Top 10 Player in the Class of 2025|first=Ryan|last=Jones|website=[[Slam (magazine)|Slam]]|date=August 12, 2024|access-date=October 4, 2024}} He tallied 21.6 points, 11.1 rebounds, five assists, 3.6 blocks, and 2.1 steals per contest to lead HIES to its first state championship. He was selected to play in the [[2025 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]] during his senior year.{{cite Caleb Wilson EMERGES as Potential Game-Changer for UNC; Jonathan Powell Paces Current Team {{!}} Draft Week for Drake Powell|website=[[WMAZ-TV|13WMAZ.com]]|date=June 23, 2025|access-date=October 30, 2025}} Wilson made headlines as a fan favorite in his second appearance for the Tar Heels after leading UNC to a victory over Kansas with a game-high 24 points.{{Citation |first=Brian |last=Murphy | title=Already a fan favorite, Wilson delivers for UNC in win over Kansas | work=[[WRAL-TV | WRAL.com]]| url=https://www.wral.com/sports/north-carolina-kansas-nonconference-mens-basketball-caleb-wilson-november-2025/ |date=November 7, 2025 | access-date=November 7, 2025}} Wilson suffered a fractured left hand on February 10, 2026, during the Tar Heels' loss to [[Miami Hurricanes men's basketball|Miami]] at the [[Watsco Center]], knocking him out indefinitely. At the time of his injury, Wilson was leading [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina]] in scoring, rebounding, steals, and blocks per game.{{Cite web |title=Caleb Wilson Out With Fracture In Left Hand |url=https://goheels.com/news/2026/2/12/mens-basketball-caleb-wilson-out-with-fracture-in-left-hand |access-date=February 12, 2026 |website=University of North Carolina Athletics |language=en}} On March 6, it was announced that Wilson would require season-ending surgery to repair a broken thumb suffered while dunking a ball during practice.{{Cite web|title=UNC's Caleb Wilson out rest of season after thumb surgery|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/48123740/sources-unc-wilson-rest-season-thumb-surgery|access-date=March 9, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===College=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2025–26 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2025–26]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2025–26 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]] | 24 || 24 || 31.3 || .578 || .259 || .713 || 9.4 || 2.7 || 1.5 || 1.4 || 19.8 {{S-end}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://goheels.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/caleb-wilson/27321 North Carolina Tar Heels bio] *[https://www.usab.com/players/caleb-wilson USA Basketball bio] {{2026 NCAA Men's Basketball Consensus All-Americans}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Wilson, Caleb}} [[Category:2006 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:21st-century American sportsmen]] [[Category:All-American college men's basketball players]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Atlanta]] [[Category:McDonald's High School All-Americans]] [[Category:North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball players]] [[Category:Power forwards]]
